technical.summary: Bullish momentum confirmed by MACD/PPO crossovers and long-term trend structure, but overbought stochRSI and weak intermediate moving average alignment limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CCI shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 61 days present material risk with no offsetting conviction signals.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (9/10) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite congressional selling by Ro Khanna; bearish sentiment (50%) and lack of recent news data warrant caution.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (400.8), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures real estate valuations, and earnings in 61 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD/PPO bullish crossovers with 50/200 EMA alignment provide technical momentum confirmation, and extreme fear sentiment (9/10) presents classic contrarian opportunity for swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), fundamental score is critically weak (2/10 with zero insider conviction), stochRSI overbought signals exhaustion, and earnings event risk in 61 days creates material downside catalyst.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (MACD/PPO crossovers) and extreme fear sentiment offer contrarian appeal, but macro headwinds and fundamental weakness do not justify new exposure.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels, flat yield curve recession signal, and earnings event in 61 days create severe downside catalyst risk that outweighs technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents bullish, but fundamental and risk agents strongly bearish; debate winner (bear) reflects macro dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding CCI position plus 5 other Real Estate positions in 155-open portfolio; sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further.
